subject: Renewal kickoff: staggered billing & license redesign for BrightLayer
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Turner <claire@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: staggered billing & license redesign for BrightLayer

Claire —

Thanks again for the pilot feedback last quarter. BrightLayer's current commit is up for renewal in November and we wanted to start a short kickoff to align on term/seat options, potential capacity uplift, and a billing cadence that fits your procurement cadence. Key goals:

- Keep your latency and commit guarantees in place while giving you flexibility to ramp seats over a quarter.
- Present a license redesign (seat+throughput mix) that reduces cost for predictable steady-state usage.
- Offer a staggered billing option (milestone-based) to align payments with your internal budget cycle.

I've attached a usage export and a first-pass amendment illustrating two options: a stepped ramp (month 1: 60% commit, month 2: 80%, month 3: 100%) or an immediate uplift with a short term discount.

Can you share 2–3 QBR slots next week where we can include procurement (to hash billing cadence) and platform engineering (to confirm capacity transition)? Proposed attendees from our side: Grace (CS lead), Tessa (account exec), me.

Attachments: usage_report_Q3.csv, proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (inline summary).

Next steps I'd like to propose:
1) You pick a QBR slot (30–45 min)
2) We confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly/quarterly/milestone)
3) Redwood to produce v2 amendment with milestone percentages and a target DocuSign date

Thanks — happy to flex.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Claire Turner <claire@brightlayer.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: 2028-10-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: staggered billing & license redesign for BrightLayer

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear kickoff. Procurement is now looped in (cc). We prefer milestone-based billing to smooth budget approval across fiscal quarters; high level preferences below:

- Milestone cadence: 30% signing, 40% go-live/ramp, 30% steady state (we can adjust percentages).
- QBR: this coming Friday 2028-10-05 at 10:00 PT works for the leadership team here — would that work for your side?
- Compliance: procurement asked for a short SOC 2 attestation summary in the amended docs.

I'll attach our procurement guidelines (PDF) for reference. If you can include a short clause for SOC 2 evidence delivery timeline, that would help speed approvals.

Claire Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships, BrightLayer Health
claire@brightlayer.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-10-01T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal kickoff: staggered billing & license redesign for BrightLayer

Forwarding Claire's response — procurement prefers milestone billing (30/40/30) and requested SOC 2 attestation timeline. QBR requested 2028-10-05 10:00 PT.

Action items for our side:
- Grace: can you confirm whether the proposed 30/40/30 schedule is within our standard uplift discounts and whether we can offer a 5% one-time onboarding credit to offset the phased commit?
- Tessa: please prep a short agenda for the QBR (30–45 min) — focus on ramp plan, capacity cutover, and SLAs.
- Monica (legal ops): we will need a v2 amendment with the billing milestones + SOC 2 attestation clause for procurement. Can you take point on a first draft?

I'll prepare updated usage slices and granular throughput numbers for the QBR.

Thanks — Ben

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-01T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal kickoff: staggered billing & license redesign for BrightLayer

Ben/Tessa —

30/40/30 is workable. Notes from pricing:
- If BrightLayer accepts milestone billing, we can hold list pricing but offer a one-time 4.5% onboarding credit reflecting the administrative and capacity reservation cost.
- If they opt for immediate uplift (100% commit) we can give a 7% term discount for a 12-month commit.
- SOC 2 attestation: we can include a clause committing to provide the latest SOC 2 report within 10 business days of signature (redacted as needed).

I've drafted a replacement amendment (proposed_amendment_v2.pdf) that includes both billing options (staged vs immediate) and the SOC 2 attestation clause. Putting Monica on the thread to finalize language.

Agenda suggestion for QBR (30 min):
1) Introductions & objectives (5 min)
2) Ramp plan and timing (10 min)
3) Billing cadence & procurement questions (10 min)
4) Next steps / DocuSign timeline (5 min)

I'll bring the uplift vs discount math and a simple chart showing expected token spend per month under each option.

Thanks — Grace

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Turner <claire@brightlayer.com>, procurement@brightlayer.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T07:48:00-07:00
Subject: Updated amendment + QBR confirmation (2028-10-05 10:00 PT)

Claire / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is proposed_amendment_v2.pdf which:
- Lays out the 30/40/30 milestone billing schedule (Option A) and an immediate-uplift option with a 7% term discount (Option B).
- Includes the SOC 2 attestation clause (we commit to provide the latest report within 10 business days of signature; redactions allowed as needed).
- Calls out a one-time 4.5% onboarding credit if you pick Option A.

QBR is confirmed for 2028-10-05 at 10:00 PT (30 min). Agenda: introductions, ramp plan, billing cadence, next steps. Tessa will send the calendar invite with a brief deck.

Claire — procurement, when you have a moment could you confirm whether the 30/40/30 percentages are acceptable or whether you'd prefer 30/35/35? Also any special DocuSign routing requirements?

Attachments: proposed_amendment_v2.pdf, usage_report_Q3.csv

Best,
Ben

From: procurement@brightlayer.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Turner <claire@brightlayer.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated amendment + QBR confirmation (2028-10-05 10:00 PT)

Ben/Team —

Procurement has reviewed proposed_amendment_v2.pdf. We can accept the milestone approach with a small tweak: 30% signing / 35% go-live / 35% steady state. That better matches our quarterly budget windows. SOC 2 timeline is acceptable.

Routing: please send DocuSign to procurement@brightlayer.com and cc legal@brightlayer.com. Once the DocuSign envelope is received we can complete approval within 5 business days.

We look forward to the QBR on 10/05 and will be prepared to confirm the milestone percentages formally there.

Procurement Team
BrightLayer Health
procurement@brightlayer.com
